rules.statement: A mere prohibition of alienation does not create a fidei commissum, unless the deed designates the persons in whose favour the property is to go over and to whom the estate shall pass in the event of its being alienated.
rules.supporting_quote: The deed would seem to provide (although even this is not absolutely clear) that on the death of Punchi Ukku without disposing of the property to any of the other three donees the property goes to Baby her adopted daughter; this, however, will not help the plaintiff whose claim is made through Mohammadu Lebbe, for in such an event the other three donees could not on any construction of the deed be the fideicommissaries.
